notes: How to use the Culture Bridge app (work-assignment A-14). Explains the app only: facts about rules, procedures, fees and dates always come from the official Q&A tools, never from this file. Keep zh-Hant and en in sync and bump version on every change.

body.zh-Hant: 手機底部的分頁：「首頁」看最新的學生貼文；「官方問答」依分類瀏覽政府機關回覆的官方問答；「看板」看與搜尋其他學生的貼文；「分享」發一篇你的經驗；「我的」看你分享和收藏的內容、帳號與語言設定。寬螢幕時這些分頁會顯示在左側。
body.en: The tabs at the bottom on phones: Home shows the latest student posts; Official Q&A lets you browse official questions answered by government agencies, by category; Boards lets you browse and search other students' posts; Share lets you post your own experience; Me shows what you shared and saved, your account and language settings. On wide screens the tabs appear on the left.

body.zh-Hant: 首頁會顯示其他學生最新分享的貼文。想查簽證、居留證、工讀、健保等規定，請到「官方問答」分頁，或直接問 AI 助理。
body.en: Home shows the latest posts shared by other students. For rules about visas, the ARC, part-time work, health insurance and more, open the Official Q&A tab or ask the assistant.

body.zh-Hant: 「官方問答」收錄教育部「大專校院境外學生輔導人員支援體系計畫（NISA）」網站上的常見問答，由內政部移民署、勞動部、健保署、教育部等機關回覆。可以依 16 個分類（例如簽證/居留證、在學期間工讀、健保/保險、畢業後留臺工作）和身分（外國學生、僑生、港澳生、陸生）篩選，也可以搜尋。每一題會列出回復機關、發布日期、資料來源和原文連結，下方還有同學分享的相關貼文。部分問題官網只有中文版，英文介面會顯示中文原文。規定可能變動，辦理前請以主管機關最新公告為準。
body.en: Official Q&A collects the FAQ of the Ministry of Education's NISA site (Network for International Student Advisors), answered by agencies such as the National Immigration Agency, the Ministry of Labor, the NHIA and the Ministry of Education. Filter by 16 categories (for example Visa and ARC, Part-time Job and Work Permits, Health and Insurance, Staying in Taiwan for Employment) and by identity (foreign, overseas Chinese, Hong Kong and Macao, mainland Chinese students), or search. Each question shows the answering agency, date, source and a link to the original, with related student posts below. Some questions exist only in Chinese on the site, so the English interface shows the Chinese original. Rules can change; check the agency's latest notice before acting.

body.zh-Hant: 學生經驗是其他國際生分享的真實感受與做法，可以在「探索」依主題（生活適應、文化與溝通）和身分（學位生、交換生、華語生）篩選。經驗是個人觀點，不是官方規定，也不會標示為已驗證；不同情境下可能有不同做法。
body.en: Student experiences are real feelings and approaches shared by other international students. In Explore you can filter by topic (life adaptation, culture and communication) and identity (degree, exchange or language student). Experiences are personal views, not official rules, and are never marked verified; different situations can call for different approaches.

body.zh-Hant: 「這對我有幫助」和「我也遇過」可以回應一則經驗；「我的經驗不同」可以分享你自己的不同經驗，並連回原本那則。「查看原文」和「查看譯文」可以切換作者的原話與 AI 翻譯。
body.en: "This helped me" and "I experienced this too" let you respond to an experience. "My experience was different" lets you share your own, linked to the original. "Show original" and "Show translation" switch between the author's words and the AI translation.

body.zh-Hant: 在「分享」寫下發生了什麼，一句話就可以，再選主題和身分類型。按「下一步：請 AI 整理重點」後，AI 會把原話整理成情境、感受和給下一位學生的提醒，方便別人看懂、搜尋，也會自動翻譯；你可以修改，再選擇用匿名、暱稱或真名，按「確認並發布」。發布前你都可以修改原話，原話也會一起保留。
body.en: In Share, write what happened (one sentence is enough), then pick a topic and identity type. Tap "Next: let AI organize it": the AI turns your words into a situation, a feeling and a tip for the next student so others can understand and find it, and translates it. Edit if needed, choose to sign anonymously, with your nickname or with your real name, then tap "Confirm and publish". You can edit your original words before publishing, and they are kept alongside.

title.zh-Hant: 為什麼要確認 AI 整理？

body.zh-Hant: AI 會把你的原話整理成情境和給下一位學生的提醒，但它可能誤解你的意思，所以一定要由你確認後才會發布。發布後的經驗會標示「AI 整理，已由作者確認」，你的原話也會一起保留。
body.en: AI turns your words into a situation and a reminder for the next student, but it can misread you, so nothing is published until you confirm it. Published experiences are labeled "AI-organized, confirmed by the author", and your original words are kept alongside.

title.en: Can others see who I am?

body.zh-Hant: 預設不會。分享的經驗預設匿名公開，不會顯示你的姓名、學校或帳號。發布時你可以自己選擇改用暱稱或真名署名，那則經驗才會顯示你填的名字；學校和帳號永遠不會公開。
body.en: Not by default. Shared experiences are public and anonymous by default: no name, school or account. When publishing you can choose to sign with your nickname or real name instead, and only then is that name shown on the experience; your school and account are never shown.

body.zh-Hant: 「我的」會列出你分享過的經驗和你的影響，例如有多少人覺得有幫助，以及你收藏的經驗。每則經驗都可以按「刪除」移除。你也可以在這裡切換語言：繁中或 English；第一次開啟時會依照手機或瀏覽器的語言。
body.en: My lists the experiences you shared and your impact, such as how many people found them helpful, and the experiences you saved. Each experience has a Delete button. You can also switch language here between 繁中 and English; the first time you open the app it follows your phone or browser language.

body.zh-Hant: 助理會根據「官方問答」回答你的問題，並告訴你是哪個機關、什麼時候回覆的；如果有同學分享過相關經驗，也會推薦那些貼文給你，並把官方問答和貼文附在回答下方，點了就能打開。學生貼文是個人經驗，不是官方規定。助理不會替你送出任何申請，也不能修改任何內容；遇到官方問答沒有提到的問題，它會直接說明，建議你向學校國際處或主管機關確認。
body.en: The assistant answers from the Official Q&A and tells you which agency answered and when. If other students have shared related experiences, it recommends those posts too, and the questions and posts it used appear as cards under the answer that you can open. Student posts are personal experience, not official rules. The assistant never submits applications for you and can't change any content; when the Official Q&A doesn't cover something, it says so and suggests asking your school's international office or the agency in charge.

title.zh-Hant: 發現資訊和實際不同怎麼辦？
title.en: What if the information doesn't match reality?

body.zh-Hant: 官方問答的內容來自教育部 NISA 網站，每題都有發布日期和原文連結；較舊的回覆可能已經不適用。辦理前請點「查看原文」確認，或直接向學校國際處、主管機關確認最新規定。
body.en: The Official Q&A comes from the MOE NISA site, and each question shows its date and a link to the original; older answers may no longer apply. Before acting, open the original or check the latest rule with your school's international office or the agency in charge.

title.en: Do I need to sign in?

body.zh-Hant: 瀏覽官方問答和學生貼文不需要登入。分享經驗、按「有幫助」等回應、收藏貼文、檢舉與封鎖、使用 AI 助理時需要登入：到「我的」按「使用 Google 帳號登入」。登出也在「我的」的「帳號」區。
body.en: You can browse the Official Q&A and student posts without an account. Sharing, reacting, saving posts, reporting or blocking, and using the assistant need you to sign in: go to Me and choose "Continue with Google". Sign out is in the Account section of Me.

body.zh-Hant: 在「看板」上方選分類，或在搜尋框輸入關鍵字，可以同時找到官方問答和學生貼文。在「官方問答」分頁也可以用分類、身分和關鍵字篩選問題。
body.en: Pick a category at the top of Boards or type keywords in the search box to find both official questions and student posts. The Official Q&A tab also filters questions by category, identity and keywords.

body.zh-Hant: 在經驗頁上方標籤旁的「⋯」選單可以「檢舉」或「封鎖這位作者」。檢舉要選原因（例如垃圾訊息、騷擾、洩漏個人資料、錯誤資訊），管理者會審查並決定是否隱藏內容。封鎖後你不會再看到這位作者的經驗，對方不會知道；要解除封鎖，到「我的」→「帳號」→「已封鎖的作者」。
body.en: Use the "⋯" menu next to the tags at the top of an experience to Report it or Block this author. A report needs a reason (for example spam, harassment, personal information, false information); a reviewer checks it and decides whether to hide the content. After blocking you won't see that author's experiences, and they aren't notified. To unblock, go to My → Account → Blocked authors.

title.en: How do I delete my account?

body.zh-Hant: 到「我的」→「帳號」→「刪除帳號」並確認。這會永久刪除你的帳號、分享的經驗、反應、收藏與助理對話，無法復原。只想移除某一則經驗的話，在「我的」那則經驗按「刪除」即可。沒有登入也可以在網站的 /account-deletion 頁面看刪除說明。
body.en: Go to My → Account → Delete account and confirm. This permanently deletes your account, shared experiences, reactions, saved experiences and assistant conversations, and can't be undone. To remove just one experience, tap Delete on it in My. The /account-deletion page on the website explains this without signing in.

body.zh-Hant: 官方問答直接取自教育部 NISA 網站，團隊不會改寫內容，官網更新後由團隊重新匯入。學生貼文的檢舉由團隊的審查者（reviewer）與管理者處理；審查者登入後會在「我的」→「帳號」看到 Admin 入口。
body.en: The Official Q&A is taken as is from the MOE NISA site; the team doesn't rewrite it and re-imports it when the site changes. Reviewers and admins on the team handle reports about student posts; reviewers see an Admin link under My → Account.

body.zh-Hant: 在經驗頁或探索的卡片上按書籤圖示就能收藏（需要登入），再按一次取消。收藏的經驗會列在「我的」→「收藏的經驗」，最新的在最上面，也可以在那裡按「取消收藏」。收藏只有你自己看得到，作者和其他人都不會知道；經驗被隱藏、刪除或作者被你封鎖後，會自動從清單消失。
body.en: Tap the bookmark on an experience page or an Explore card to save it (sign-in needed); tap again to remove it. Saved experiences are listed under My → Saved experiences, newest first, where you can also remove them. Only you can see what you saved; authors and other people are never told. If an experience is hidden, deleted or its author is blocked, it drops off the list.

body.zh-Hant: 暱稱和真實姓名都可以不填，在「我的」→「個人資料」修改（第一次登入時也會問一次，可以「稍後再說」）。發布經驗時可以選擇「匿名」（預設）、「暱稱」或「真名」；只有選了才會顯示在那則經驗上，選真名時所有人都看得到。之後改名或清空，已發布的經驗也會跟著更新。學校和帳號永遠不會公開。
body.en: Both a nickname and a real name are optional; edit them under My → Your names (you are also asked once after first signing in, and can skip). When publishing an experience you choose Anonymous (the default), Nickname or Real name; a name only appears on experiences you sign with it, and a real name is visible to everyone. Renaming or clearing it later updates those experiences. Your school and account are never shown.
